name: Deyo Supply Company
old_description: All of the gear and items made to get you through the grit and grime. From headlights to waxed jackets, we have the items needed to get you there.
about:
Deyo Supply Company operates from St. Francisville, Louisiana. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The company presents itself as a curated retailer for the modern outdoorsman.

The company sells outdoor gear, clothing, footwear, and accessories from a roster of established brands such as Choona, Howler Bros, Marsh Wear, Peter Millar, Martin Dingman, Onward Reserve, Duck Head, Genteal, Faherty, GenTeal, Johnnie-O, Criquet, Fenix, Stanley, and Yes Cocktail Co. Product categories include outerwear, footwear, hats, button-down shirts, dress shirts, everyday carry items, and headlamps. The business runs an e-commerce site with free shipping on orders over $75 and maintains a physical presence in St. Francisville.

Deyo Supply targets consumers who move between field and town, serving hunters, anglers, and outdoor enthusiasts. The merchandise spans waterfowl, big-game, and fishing pursuits, as well as casual and refined wear for social occasions. The company does not appear to serve industrial or B2B manufacturing markets.

The brand positions itself around the tagline "Savagely Civilized, Wildly Refined" and the concept "From Duck Blind to Dinner," emphasizing versatility from rugged use to evening wear. This positioning is offered as the company's distinguishing idea.

name: Diamond Apparel Manufacturing
old_description: Contract screen printing and embroidery with outstanding quality, speed, and transparency.
about:
Based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey, Diamond Apparel Manufacturing operates as a contract screen printing and embroidery provider. The company serves clients ranging from Fortune 500 corporations to emerging apparel brands, offering decoration services on orders from a few hundred to 10,000 pieces.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, and private-label services supported by in-house graphic artists who deliver design proofs within 24 hours. Daily production turnaround times are posted on a client portal, and an online pricing tool allows quick quotes. The facility also builds integrated online stores in five to seven business days, handles product sourcing, and ships via UPS, FedEx, USPS, and LTL with blind-shipment options. Free inbound freight is offered to contract customers.

Customers include large enterprises, promotional distributors, multi-location franchises, and schools. The company emphasizes transparency, dedicated account representatives, and technology investments to meet tight deadlines.

Diamond Apparel Manufacturing was founded to deliver a competitive, transparent contract decoration relationship that helps clients grow their business and retain customers through quality, speed, and end-to-end visibility.

name: Dielectric Manufacturing Iowa
old_description: Milwaukee-Area Contract Manufacturer of Precision Plastic and Metal Parts and Components, With Value-Added Services
about:
Dielectric Manufacturing operates from a 100,000-square-foot headquarters in Richfield, Wisconsin, just northwest of Milwaukee, with additional production plants in Waupaca, Wisconsin; Lake Mills, Iowa; and Richmond, Illinois. The company traces its roots to 1966 when Ray Esser founded Dielectric Corporation in central Wisconsin. The Esser family retains private ownership, and the name was updated to Dielectric Manufacturing in 2019 to reflect expanded capabilities beyond plastics into metal machining and carbon fiber composites.

The firm functions as a single-source contract manufacturer, handling design collaboration, prototyping, machining, fabrication, welding, finishing, assembly, kitting, packaging, and inventory management. Its equipment roster includes vertical and horizontal machining centers, 5-axis milling, 6-axis laser cutting, routing, stamping, turning, bending, cold forming, and plastic and metal welding. The Richfield facility opened in 2020; the Waupaca site specializes in ferrous metals, while the Richmond location, acquired in October 2025 as EMS Industrial & Service Co., produces busbars. All three Wisconsin and Iowa plants hold ISO 9001:2015 certification, and the Waupaca operation maintains ITAR registration through the DDTC.

Customers span aerospace, agriculture, defense, electrical, food processing, gas and oil, health care and medical equipment, power generation and distribution (including wind), power sports, marine, and data centers. The client base ranges from small businesses to Fortune 500 companies such as Eaton Corporation's Power Systems Division. Dielectric also distributes unfinished thermoplastics, thermosets, ferrous and non-ferrous metals, and carbon fiber composites in sheet, rod, tube, and block forms.

The company emphasizes a partner-oriented approach, offering material selection guidance and design-for-manufacturability input to reduce cost and lead time. Standard lead times are quoted at two weeks, with expedited turnaround demonstrated on urgent orders. ITAR compliance and ongoing CMMC 2.0 implementation support defense-sector work.

name: Dietary Equipment Co.
old_description: Dietary Equipment has been a Partner in the Foodservice Industry for over 30 years
about:
Dietary Equipment Co. operates from Columbia, South Carolina, where it has served the foodservice industry for more than three decades. The company's ownership structure and founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The firm functions as a distributor and solutions provider for commercial foodservice equipment, smallwares, and janitorial supplies. Its catalog spans commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, food preparation machinery, warewashing systems, shelving, and furniture from brands such as Arctic Air, Lakeside, Unox, and Metro. Beyond product sales, Dietary Equipment offers kitchen design, project management, installation, and ongoing maintenance and parts support for institutional and commercial kitchens.

Customers range from independent restaurants to large-scale institutions. The company explicitly serves healthcare facilities including assisted living communities, nursing homes, and hospital medical labs; military installations; correctional facilities; schools and universities; concession and catering operations; and humanitarian disaster relief projects. It holds a GSA contract (47QSWA19D001J) and participates in healthcare buying groups through the Strata GPO.

Dietary Equipment emphasizes a consultative approach, promoting personal support from design through delivery and installation. Its GSA schedule and GPO membership enable streamlined procurement for government and institutional buyers, while its brand-agnostic product selection allows specification flexibility across diverse project requirements.

name: Digicom Electronics
old_description: is a certified Small Business that has been proudly manufacturing electronics in the California Bay Area since 1982.
about:
Digicom Electronics, a certified small business, has been manufacturing electronics in Oakland, California since 1982. The company operates as a subsidiary of India-based Kaynes Technology Group, combining U.S.-based production with global supply-chain resources.

The shop provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed technology), cable and wire harness fabrication, box build, and full test sequences such as functional, burn-in, optical, and X-ray inspection. An advanced high-speed SMT line supports larger volumes, while a newly expanded stock room and kitting operation feed quick-turn prototypes and low- to mid-volume production runs. Turnkey and consignment programs are managed with dedicated program oversight.

Customers span aerospace, defense, medical devices, industrial automation, IT and telecommunications, and railway sectors. A noted project includes the ROACH system built for CASPER and radio astronomy institutes, which contributed to the first image of a black hole. The firm emphasizes secure, compliant builds for defense-grade electronics and precision manufacturing for life-saving medical innovations.

Digicom differentiates itself through its ITAR-registered, U.S.-based facility, AS9100/ISO 9001/ISO 13485/NADCAP certifications, and the backing of Kaynes Group’s international scale. The company quotes standard builds in two business days and complex new-product introductions in five, and it specializes in small runs, NPI support, and design-to-troubleshoot assistance for challenging electronic products.

name: Dignity Apparel Tennessee
old_description: Creating Jobs In The USA Through Responsible Clothing Manufacturing
about:
Dignity Apparel Tennessee operates from New Tazewell, Tennessee. The company was established with a mission to create dignified, life-changing jobs through responsible clothing manufacturing in the United States, focusing on a fully domestic value chain.

The company produces a range of apparel including hooded sweatshirts, t-shirts, and polos. It runs a knitting mill in Tennessee where union-knit fabric and fleece are made from U.S.-sourced yarn. Cutting and sewing are performed at union facilities in Iowa and Tennessee, while dyeing is handled by various U.S. dye houses. The operation covers the full garment production value chain from cotton growing through finished goods.

Dignity Apparel serves wholesale buyers, private-label brands, and customers seeking custom apparel or fabric sales. Its product line includes 9‑ounce hooded pullovers and full‑zip sweatshirts, 6‑ounce premium tees, 5.5‑ounce everyday tees, and moisture‑wicking polos for men and women.

The company emphasizes that its garments are born, built, and sewn in the USA using 100 % U.S.-sourced cotton and a union workforce. It positions its domestic supply chain and commitment to fair wages and safe working conditions as its primary differentiators.

Direct Kitchen Equipment operates from Brooklyn, New York, as a family-run business. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders' names. It began with a focus on supplying commercial kitchen equipment and has expanded to offer design and consulting services.

The company distributes a wide range of commercial kitchen equipment, including refrigeration, cooking, prep, warming, and beverage appliances from brands such as American Range, Cadco, Dukers, Henny Penny, PizzaMaster, Sirman, Unox, and Winco. Beyond equipment sales, Direct Kitchen Equipment provides kitchen design, custom walk-in boxes, hood systems, and financing options. It does not manufacture products but acts as a supplier and service provider for food-service operations.

The primary customers are commercial kitchens, restaurants, and food-service establishments needing complete kitchen solutions. The company’s offerings target operators looking for everything from reach-in refrigerators and convection ovens to walk-in coolers and ventilation systems.

Direct Kitchen Equipment emphasizes trust, integrity, and personalized customer service as its core differentiators, describing its approach as treating every customer like family. The business was built on delivering quality, reliability, and personal care throughout the project lifecycle.

name: Diversified Wire & Cable
old_description: Diversified Wire & Cable is a nationally recognized manufacturer of custom fiber optic and copper cable assemblies.
about:
Diversified Wire & Cable is headquartered in Sterling Heights, Michigan, with additional locations in Wisconsin and Gainesville, Georgia. The company was formed through a merger with Great Lakes Wire & Cable to create GLD Group, Inc., a combined resource for networking and cabling communications products and services.

The company manufactures custom fiber optic and copper cable assemblies and operates a wire and cable distribution division that stocks electrical, electronic, voice, data, and security products. Its professional services design team provides wireless network design for Wi‑Fi, microwave, and specialty technologies, distributed antenna system (DAS) design for public‑safety and enterprise cellular customers, and custom cabinet building for IT data centers. Diversified also offers hosted training programs and holds iBwave Wi‑Fi certifications.

Diversified serves public‑safety first responders, enterprise cellular users, IT data centers, and the broader telecommunications and cabling communications market. Its distribution and design services support customers in networking infrastructure, wireless deployments, and data‑center build‑outs.

The company differentiates itself through what it calls “Extreme Service,” a philosophy built on intelligent solutions, total dependability, and a proactive approach. It emphasizes compliance with BICSI, TIA, and IEEE standards, pre‑stocks inventory to meet tight deadlines, and aims to identify cost‑effective alternatives before customers request them.
